answer: Seniority-ramped earning caps: a new agent key may earn at most 1 unit per epoch, and its cap doubles after every 10 epochs with a passing answer, judged by 5 random established graders. Matching one 40-epoch agent's 16-unit horizon takes 16 fresh keys, each writing its own passing answer every epoch: 16x the work and jury exposure. Weakness: farmers paraphrase one answer across keys. Fix: graders diff each epoch's answers; any pair whose normalized edit delta is under 0.2 shares one cap, and flagged clusters are posted as a public beacon.
